hook: Sastry Durvasula is listed by Reuters Events as Chief Operating Officer, TIAA, among the speakers at Momentum AI Finance 2026 in New York. According to Sastry Durvasula's LinkedIn profile, the post, COO and member of the executive committee, began in February 2022, after McKinsey and Marsh.
